messages:
jordan: AM check-in — quick async for the OrbitalHealth deal. Two asks from them: (1) KMS/HSM performance + mutual TLS for log forwarding, (2) CR review for PR#4789 (model routing + canary). What I did / blockers / today

maya: Did the onboarding call yesterday, sent draft MSA. What I did: captured security checklist. Blocker: customer insists on pushing KMS audit logs into their Splunk instance (mTLS). Today: confirm Splunk endpoint details and retention days.

kim: I can take the KMS/HSM side. Quick note: our HSM keywrap latency on Dedicated was ~12ms median in last bench (12ms @ 98th ~28ms) — need expected QPS to size properly. For Splunk ingestion we support mTLS + signed certs. Blocker: need customer CA cert or cross-signed cert.

oliver: Picking up PR#4789 for review now. Initial pass: routing policy looks good, but question about fallback model — current config falls back to `llama-30b-ff8` which has different tokenization; suggest `llama-13b-q4` as compatibility fallback. Will post inline comments. No blocker besides CR.

sec-bot: @channel Enterprise checklist reminder: enable audit logs (retention 90d default), customer-managed keys required for on-prem/private. See internal doc: https://intranet.redwood/enterprise/kms-hsm. :lock:

jordan: @kim / @oliver — quick ask: can you confirm whether mutual TLS for Splunk means we should provision a client cert from our side or let customer present client cert to their endpoint? Also, Oliver, if we change fallback model we need to update canary rollout matrix to include cost/latency guardrails.

kim: We typically support both modes: (A) Redwood presents client cert to customer's Splunk (we provision cert + rotate) or (B) customer requires us to verify using their client cert. Option A is easier for them but needs legal sign-off for cert custody. I'll draft the cert provisioning template.

maya: I'll ask the customer which option they prefer and whether their Splunk supports client cert rotation API. Also requesting retention policy — do they want 1y? 90d?

oliver: Quick note on deployment: if fallback moves to `llama-13b-q4`, the perf delta is ~6-8ms per token on our infra (benchmark suite). Canary matrix should set token-latency SLO + QPS threshold, and automatic rollback if 5xx spike. I'll add those lines to the PR.

jordan: Small helper snippet for Eng/Ops to forward logs (for the docs page). Sharing example curl + minimal config — @kim please adapt for cert fields.

```
# example: forward logs to customer Splunk HC using mTLS
curl -v --cert ./client.pem --key ./client.key
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  --data '{"event":"audit","payload":"..."}'
  https://splunk-customer.example.com:8088/services/collector/event
```

```
# example config snippet for our side
kms_proxy:
  endpoint: "https://kms.redwood.internal/v1"
  tls:
    client_cert: "/etc/redwood/certs/client.pem"
    ca_cert: "/etc/redwood/certs/customer-ca.pem"
```

kim: Drafting the cert template now (will post in thread). If customer wants option A, we'll need legal + infra signoff.

maya: Next steps from sales: (1) ask customer for Splunk host + expected retention + preferred cert mode, (2) confirm QPS estimate so Kim can size HSM pool, (3) wait on PR#4789 comments from Oliver.

oliver: Done — leaving a few inline comments, will ping again after updates.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: canary for `llama-13b-q4` test cluster scheduled at 15:30 PST if PR merges.

jordan: Thanks team — updating deal card with blockers: awaiting customer CA cert and Splunk endpoint + retention choice. I'll ping Legal for cert custody clause. :thumbsup:

maya: I'll update CRM and follow up with a 1:1 today.

kim: Adding action: I'll prepare a short runbook for cert rotation and mtls setup.

oliver: No further blockers from eng; will re-review once PR updated.

jordan: Closing the loop here — if anyone sees a blocker pop up, reply in-thread. Otherwise I'll log these actions on the deal.
